lean.statement: For every complete finite-dimensional real-inner-product Borel space E, incoming probability law ν on E×E, xstar∈E, h>=0, and integrable incoming energy with integral at most M, under μ=ν.prod(stdGaussian E), X((x,p),z)=x, and P0((x,p),z)=exp(-h/2)p+sqrt(1-exp(-h))z are measurable, their combined squared energy is integrable, its integral equals the damped incoming integral plus (1-exp(-h))*finrank(E), and it is bounded by M plus that Gaussian term.
approved_definition_context: The product measure of the incoming state law and stdGaussian gives a genuinely fresh independent Gaussian coordinate.
All displayed integrals are real Bochner integrals; measurability and integrability are separate conclusions before the exact identity and inequality.
finrank is the real dimension, and the nonnegative phase length makes exp(-h) at most one.
